# Support SLA

## Response times

Priority 1 incidents receive a first response within 1 hour, 24/7. Priority 2 incidents receive a first response within 4 business hours. Priority 3 requests are answered within 2 business days.

## Channels

Support is available through the ticketing portal, Slack Connect and WhatsApp. Phone support is reserved for Priority 1 incidents.

## Maintenance windows

Planned maintenance happens on Tuesdays between 02:00 and 04:00 CET and is announced 48 hours in advance.
